summary: Dynamic prompt-side lesson-state steering: server-computed [LESSON STATE] block per turn, procedural wording replacing abstract prohibitions, executor-side record_step_actions dedupe.
final_report: T72 done. Prompt-side lesson-state steering implemented exactly per the user prescription. app/llm/messages.py: new build_lesson_state_block(state) renders the changing [LESSON STATE] lines (teaching turns count, Greeting already delivered/not yet given, Core definition taught/not yet taught, Nesting-dolls analogy used/unused, learner's last message truncated to 200 chars, plus the procedure line: apply state, skip covered material, back-reference, teach the next unresolved piece, end with one new check question); make_system_prompt gains optional lesson_state param inserting the block after SESSION CONTEXT; build_chat_messages passes it through. TUTOR_TOOL_GUIDANCE prohibition sentences replaced with procedural ones ('Begin each reply by applying LESSON STATE: skip covered material, advance to new ground.'), voice-continuity sentence kept, micro-rules added ('Greet only when Greeting says not yet given.', 'Call record_step_actions at most once per reply.'). app/services/sessions/turn.py: computes state each turn over the existing conn (assistant COUNT partial=0 -> teaching_turns/greeting_done/definition_taught; dolls_used EXISTS LIKE '%nesting dolls%'/'%matryoshka%'; last_user_text=current user_text) and passes lesson_state into build_chat_messages; agentic loop carries step_actions_recorded flag - a duplicate record_step_actions call is absorbed WITHOUT execute_tool, yielding tool_result note 'actions already recorded this turn' while still appending the role:tool JSON so the loop stays consistent; stash/web_sources untouched (note-guard prevents the [] clobbering real actions); flag set only after a successful first execution so invalid_action retries stay possible. tests/test_api_chat_sse.py extended with test_second_turn_system_prompt_carries_lesson_state (asserts second-turn system prompt contains [LESSON STATE], 'Teaching turns completed so far: 1.', 'Greeting: already delivered.', dolls unused, echoed last user message; first turn asserts not-yet-given) and test_duplicate_record_step_actions_absorbed_by_executor (monkeypatched executor counter proves execute_tool ran once for record_step_actions; two tool_result events '1 actions' then '0 actions'; done.actions keeps only the first call's action; follow-up messages contain the exact note JSON under tool_call_id call_a2). IMPORTANT framing: the state line is metadata steering like BROT's memory blocks - server-computed context injected fresh each turn - NOT output scrubbing; nothing mutates or filters model output. The uvicorn --reload watcher auto-applies these changes on save.
